Excellent grill with even heat and cooking, with only 1 problem.  

The tank level gauge will not work with our areas propane bottles, as they have a wider curved out handle for a comfortable grip while carrying, and the clip on the gauge is not wide enough to support the tank.  And since the bottom has a larger diameter hole that the tank drops thru, you can't just set the tank inside.   This causes us to install/remove the tank every time we use the grill, which is a pain.

Results.ReviewText: Installing a full tank of propane is a major undertaking. Between the weight of the tank and the design of the combined hanger/gauge it is unmanageable. I had to put a piece of plywood over the hole in the tray bottom to set the tank on and use wedges to get it up on the hanger/gauge. Maybe redesigning the diameter of the hole in the bottom tray to accommodate the average 15-20# propane tank diameter without it dropping through to the ground below. Other than that, I absolutely love the grill.

Results.ReviewText: The gas tank sits on the ground. my old Weber had a smaller hole and the base of the tank fit into that. It was much easier to maneuver the grill. Why put wheels on a grill when you can't easily move it. Poor design.
Results.Title: Why wheels?

Results.ReviewText: My wife back in about 2016 or so bought me for fathers day an E-210. I have loved that grill. It is one of the best grills I have ever had. I had a chance to get this E-310 for free. That's right free. It was an award I received for job performance and training I did through the year. Please, do not for a second think the E-210 is not a great grill because it is. But, the E-310 is the bomb. I absolutely love this grill. What I like is how quickly it recovers after you open it to turn what ever you are cooking. The extra space is a God send. We do a lot of social events during the spring and summer so being able to cook more items is going to be nice. I think the only thing I would like is if the side tables folded down like the 210. I am not hip about the cover I got either. It does not cover the bottom well enough. I can live with those shortcomings. The other thing I have to say is I have had Weber grills for years. In my opinion they are the best. I have used competition grills when cooking at friends events and I can honestly say I like my Weber's the best. If you are thinking about buying one of these don't hesitate. It is worth every penny.

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
